SUBZERO_WISP;4 }} The '''Wisp Pet''' is a craftable [[Crude Gabagool|Gabagool]] [[Pet]]: rather than gaining XP traditionally, it must be fed Gabagool to level up, and resets its level upon gaining a rarity. It is designed for [[Blaze Slayer]]. == Obtaining == The '''Wisp Pet''' is obtained as a craftable pet at {{Coll|Blaze Slayer LVL 1}}. === Crafting === {{Crafting Recipe Table |{{Crafting Recipe Row |name = {{Uncommon}} [[Droplet Wisp Pet]] |requirement = {{Coll|Blaze Slayer 1}} |A1 = Derelict Ashe |B1 = Derelict Ashe |C1 = Derelict Ashe |A2 = Derelict Ashe |B2 = Omega Enchanted Egg |C2 = Derelict Ashe |A3 = Derelict Ashe |B3 = Derelict Ashe |C3 = Derelict Ashe |Output = Droplet Wisp Pet }} }} == Upgrading == The '''Wisp Pet''' cannot be upgraded at {{NPCSprite|Kat}}, and must be upgraded with [[Wisp Upgrade Stone]]s. Each '''Wisp Upgrade Stone''' can be crafted with drops from the {{MobSprite|Inferno Demonlord}}. {{Crafting Recipe Table |show_name = yes |{{Crafting Recipe Row|Wisp Upgrade Stone (Rare)}} |{{Crafting Recipe Row|Wisp Upgrade Stone (Epic)}} |{{Crafting Recipe Row|Wisp Upgrade Stone (Legendary)}} }} Upon gaining a rarity, the '''Wisp Pet''' gains a new prefix and resets its level. == |15||125,000||+585||+58 |- |16||150,000||+595||+59 |- |17||200,000||+600||+60 |} == Skins == {{Item Skins|Subzero Wisp Pet}} == Trivia == *The '''Wisp Pet''' was the first pet added to not have an attributed [[Skills|Skill]]. *It is also the first pet that doesn't level up through gaining skill experience. **It is also the first pet that requires a consumable item to level up. **The pet experience gained from feeding is affected by {{NPCSprite|Derpy;Mayor Derpy}}'s {{AN|MOAR SKILLZ!!!}} perk, which reduces the required amount of [[Gabagool (disambiguation)|Gabagool]] items by around {{Green|33.3%}} during his mayorship. **Since feeding the [[Pets|pet]] will consume the entire stack held in hand, it is possible to overfeed the pet right before it reaches level 100. *The '''Wisp Pet''' is the only pet that changes name depending on its [[rarity]]. *The '''Wisp Pet''' is the only pet that has a level requirement to be upgraded. *If one buys a '''Wisp Pet''' from the [[Auction House]] or through trading, without the proper Blaze Slayer level, its perks wouldn't activate. *The '''Wisp Pet''' is the only pet that starts as at {{Uncommon}}. *The {{attr|Battle Experience}}
